claim: 27 patient samples were sequenced; 25 by both platforms and 2 by ONT only, because Ion Torrent data were unavailable for those two
quote: Of these, 25 samples were sequenced using both Ion Torrent and ONT methods, whereas 2 samples were sequenced with ONT only because of the unavailability of Ion Torrent sequencing data.

claim: For the 25 samples run on both platforms, concordance was complete: every SNV and small indel found by Ion Torrent was also found by ONT
quote: The analysis of 25 samples that were sequenced with both methods showed complete concordance. Every SNV and small insertion/deletion identified by Ion Torrent was also detected by ONT.

claim: Three truncating BRCA1 variants were found across the cohort by both platforms
quote: Throughout the cohort, the following variants were identified (Table 2): BRCA1 c.4120_4121del p.(Ser1374Ter), BRCA1 c.4432G>T p.(Glu1478Ter), and BRCA1 c.3403C>T p.(Gln1135Ter).

claim: 17 of the patients were negative for clinically relevant variants on both sequencing platforms
quote: Notably, 17 patients tested negative for clinically relevant variants on both sequencing platforms, emphasizing the robustness of the results.

claim: ONT found a 312-bp intronic AluYa5 insertion in BRCA2 in four patients that Ion Torrent missed
quote: This included a previously reported 312-bp intronic AluYa5 insertion in BRCA2

claim: In the two ONT-only patients, BRCA2 c.4504C>G was detected and classified as a variant of uncertain significance
quote: the BRCA2 c.4504C>G p.(Gln1502Glu) variant was detected and classified as a variant of uncertain significance

claim: A deep intronic BRCA1 variant, c.5333-898A>G, was identified in one ONT-only patient and confirmed by Sanger sequencing
quote: Additionally, a deep intronic variant, BRCA1 c.5333898A>G p.(?), was identified in one of the patients, and this finding was subsequently confirmed through

claim: The deep intronic BRCA1 variant would have been missed by Ion Torrent because that panel targets exons and nearby splice sites rather than deep intronic sequence
quote: This variant would not have been detected using the coding-focused Ion Torrent platform, as its targeted design primarily focuses on exonic regions and nearby splice sites, rather than deep intronic sequences.

claim: The deep intronic BRCA1 variant was absent from gnomAD version 4
quote: variant was not reported in the Genome Aggregation Database version 4.

claim: SpliceAI and Pangolin both predicted a novel cryptic donor splice site and activation of a pseudoexon for the deep intronic BRCA1 variant
quote: both of which strongly indicated the formation of a novel cryptic donor splice site and the activation of a pseudoexon

claim: SpliceAI gave the novel splice site a delta gain score of 0.84, far above the usual pathogenic cutoff of 0.2, and Pangolin gave 0.81 at the same position
quote: with SpliceAI generating a strong predicted gain (Δ GAIN) score of 0.84 for a novel splice site, exceeding the typical pathogenic cutoff of >0.2

claim: A secondary gain event near the primary one was predicted by both tools, at 0.66 by SpliceAI and 0.62 by Pangolin
quote: The models also predicted a secondary gain event (SpliceAI Δ GAIN: 0.66; Pangolin Δ GAIN: 0.62) near the primary event.

claim: Human Splicing Finder added cryptic donor and acceptor sites, branch point changes, and altered enhancer and silencer motifs
quote: provided complementary evidence by identifying new cryptic donor and acceptor sites, changes in predicted branch points, and alterations in splicing enhancer and silencer motifs

claim: The BRCA2 AluYa5 structural variant scored below 0.2 on splicing prediction, so its effect, if any, is unlikely to be spliceogenic
quote: an insertion of an intronic Alu element from the Alu Ya5 family, showed low Δ scores (<0.2), indicating no predicted splicing alteration

claim: BRCA1 and BRCA2 were covered by six and four overlapping long-range PCR products respectively, generating fragments of about 22 kb
quote: Six overlapping long-range PCR products were designed to provide comprehensive coverage of the BRCA1 gene, along with four additional overlapping long-range PCR products targeting the BRCA2 gene

claim: The pooled barcoded library from all samples was run on a single R10.4.1 flow cell for 24 hours on a MinION Mk1C
quote: The pooled, barcoded library from all samples was loaded onto one R10.4.1 flow cell (FLO-MIN114) and sequenced for 24 hours on the MinION Mk1C sequencer.

claim: The Ion Torrent comparator was a custom AmpliSeq panel covering 28 hereditary breast cancer genes, designed to cover coding exons and flanking intronic regions
quote: Target enrichment was performed using a customdesigned Ion AmpliSeq panel covering 28 genes implicated in hereditary breast cancer, including BRCA1 and

claim: ONT reads were aligned to GRCh38 with minimap2, small variants called with Clair3 and structural variants with Sniffles2
quote: For variant calling, SNVs and insertion/deletion variants were identified for each sample using Clair3 version 1.0.10.16 SVs from the mapped ONT reads were identified using Sniffles2 version 2.4.17

claim: ONT devices cost roughly 10 to 20 times less up front than the Ion Torrent platform, and barcoding lowers per-sample cost
quote: ONT sequencing devices are generally less expensive than the Ion Torrent platform, with upfront costs approximately 10 to 20 times lower.

claim: Ion Torrent library preparation was fully automated on the Ion Chef while the ONT workflow was largely manual and needed careful long-range PCR optimization
quote: In contrast, ONT followed a largely manual workflow.

claim: The authors expect the incremental benefit of long-read sequencing to shrink on large multigene panels, where short-read remains more scalable and cost-efficient
quote: the incremental benefits of long-read NGS would likely decrease if applied to large multigene panels, where short-read NGS remains a more scalable and cost-efficient option

claim: The proposed model keeps short-read NGS as the primary method for broad panels, with targeted long-read as a focused first-line or reflex test
quote: a model is proposed in which short-read NGS serves as the primary method for broad panels, whereas targeted long-read NGS may be used as a focused first-line or reflex test.

claim: The clinical significance of the BRCA2 AluYa5 insertion detected in four patients remains to be established
quote: The clinical significance of this variant remains to be established.

claim: RNA sequencing could not be done because patient RNA samples were unavailable, so splicing impact was assessed only in silico
quote: RNA sequencing could not be performed because of the unavailability of patient RNA samples, which limited the ability to directly assess the functional impact of the detected variants on transcript splicing and expression.

claim: The small sample size limits the statistical significance of the conclusions
quote: The sample size analyzed remains relatively small, which may limit the statistical significance of the conclusions.
